data: What is the highest percentage of female employment displayed in the figure?

The graph shows the percentage of females employed over time. The y-axis represents the percentage of females employed, ranging from 27% to 35%. The x-axis represents years from 1950 to 1990. The line on the graph fluctuates but generally increases over time. The highest point on the graph appears to be around 34%, which is reached near the end of the period shown. Therefore, the highest percentage of female employment displayed in the figure is approximately 34%.
